name: Diff Viewer
description: Renders unified diffs with ANSI colors and exposes a ShowDiff tool.

tool.name: ShowDiff
tool.description: Render a unified diff with ANSI colors and return the colored text. Use it when the diff is the primary content of the reply. Do not use it for a hunk that must sit inside a longer explanation. Use the inline `<ma::emit::diff>` tag for that case instead. Do not paste raw patch text into the reply. Returns one string of colored diff text. Additions are lime green and deletions are hot pink.

patch.description: The full unified diff text to render, from git diff or diff -u.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the diff.
